content: Weaviate filters (official docs + client refs, cross-verified): operator enum Equal/NotEqual/GreaterThan/GreaterThanEqual/LessThan/LessThanEqual/Like/ContainsAll/ContainsAny/ContainsNone/IsNull/WithinGeoRange; nested And/Or operands; Like wildcard */? scans whole inverted index (linear cost warning); typed value fields valueText/Int/Number/Boolean/Date. Hybrid: relativeScoreFusion default since v1.24 (normalizes each leg), rankedFusion 1/(rank+60) legacy; alpha default 0.75 (set explicitly); max vector distance threshold applies to vector leg only, no BM25 threshold. GAP: hybrid+where timing not explicit on concepts page; two URL attempts 404.
